items.notes: DoL DBA Waiver No. 2026-02 confirmed from the dol.gov PDF (downloaded through WebFetch; PDF metadata created 26 Mar 2026) and dol.gov's DBA waiver list (South Korea, 2026-02, issued 2026-03-26, expires 2031-03-25): general waiver for all U.S. agencies and all contracts at any location in Korea; covers employees under Korea's compulsory workers' compensation laws with a fully conforming employer (C, D.2); excludes U.S. citizens, lawful U.S. residents and persons hired in the United States (D.1); third-country nationals' benefits must survive repatriation (C); employer must provide WHCA-equivalent protection for waived employees (D.4); prior Korea waivers revoked (F).
